headline: Last session: Sensex gained 308 points and Nifty reclaimed 23,000 driven by positive market momentum.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 3 November.

why: Markets are closed today, Sunday 1 November 2026, on account of the weekend.
Benchmark indices rebounded in the last trading session backed by gains in major heavyweights.
Festive demand boosted October GST collections to ₹2.31 lakh crore, supporting positive broader sentiment.
Strong corporate announcements and production recovery updates provided stock-specific support.
whatHappening: In the last trading day, Sensex settled at 74,459.53 while Nifty 50 gained 116.35 points.
Coal India recorded a 19% increase in production as mining operations recovered post-monsoon.
CCI approved the merger between Devyani International and Sapphire Foods to unify KFC and Pizza Hut operations.
Syngene retained its full-year outlook, expecting a stronger second half powered by order book growth.
summary:
On the last trading day, Indian equity markets closed on a positive note with Sensex settling at 74,459.53 and Nifty rising 0.51%.
Economic activity remained strong as GST collections surged 23% in October to ₹2.31 lakh crore amid festive demand.
Stock-specific action saw Coal India post 19% output growth, CCI greenlight the Devyani-Sapphire merger, and Syngene express confidence in strong H2 performance.
